scope: Pointwise continuous linear Spin_0(7,7)-equivariant maps from finite-dimensional released GU field fibres into K1335's infinite-dimensional irreducible principal-series Hilbert representation; not maps on section spaces, distributional intertwiners, induced transforms, nonlinear maps or nonlocal observation rules.

finite_fibre_theorem.domain: a finite-dimensional pointwise G-module V representing one released source fibre or a finite direct sum of such fibres
finite_fibre_theorem.codomain: the nontrivial infinite-dimensional irreducible unitary representation H_ps
finite_fibre_theorem.candidate: a continuous linear G-equivariant map T:V->H_ps
finite_fibre_theorem.image_invariance: equivariance makes im T a G-invariant subspace
finite_fibre_theorem.closure: finite-dimensional subspaces of a Hilbert space are closed
finite_fibre_theorem.irreducibility_step: closed invariant im T is either zero or all H_ps
finite_fibre_theorem.dimension_step: finite-dimensional im T cannot equal infinite-dimensional H_ps

covered: pointwise linear maps from finite-dimensional epsilon/varpi/nu/zeta fibre data
pointwise linear maps from the 91-dimensional adjoint fibre
finite direct sums of released finite source fibres
not_covered: maps from infinite-dimensional spaces of source sections
differential or integral transforms with infinite-dimensional image

claim_ceiling: No released finite-dimensional GU field fibre maps nontrivially and linearly into the irreducible infinite-dimensional principal-series matter fibre while preserving the full split-D7 action. The result is pointwise and linear; it does not exclude section-space, differential, integral, distributional, nonlinear or symmetry-reduced bridges.
